Rubio Said Trump Wants to End the Iran War 'Peacefully.' Oil Prices Are Plunging.
Source: International Business Times (syndicated on Yahoo Finance) | Author: Demian Bio | Monday 2 November 2026, 12:42 PM GMT

Oil benchmarks declined sharply on Monday following signals that U.S.-Iran negotiations may be progressing. Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated the Trump administration would prefer resolving the conflict "diplomatically."
- Brent crude fell 3.95%, dropping below $109/barrel
- West Texas Intermediate declined 4.18%, falling below $100/barrel
Rubio stated that while Trump has not finalized a decision, the administration "would prefer to do it peacefully," though he emphasized military readiness as a backup option.

Vice President JD Vance sent a letter to Iranian military leader Mohsen Rezaei, which generated momentum for talks. A proposal—supported by Qatar, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey—would allow UN nuclear inspectors site access in exchange for sanctions relief.
Iran has demanded the U.S. lift its port blockade and release frozen funds before proceeding. Officials indicated they would present the proposal to Supreme Leader Khamenei within days for approval.
The framework aims to allow both sides to claim diplomatic victories without Iran surrendering enriched uranium upfront or the U.S. appearing to make unilateral concessions.
